card.name: Chemistry citations and chemical wording
card.fires_on: Spaces before page numbers in chemistry journal references, and linking words or fragments in chemical or drug text such as 'which' or 'that' after a list of substances.

modes.label: Journal reference pages
modes.description: The space after the volume number, just before page numbers in a chemistry journal citation.
modes.example: (I) coordination chemistry: From 1-D chains to molecular rectangles, New J. Chem., 2013, 37,<< >>204-2011

modes.label: Lab reagent purity
modes.description: Digits or percent signs in solvent grade descriptions such as HPLC grade.
modes.example: 9% aqueous sodium chloride (non-bacteriostatic) 50% aqueous acetonitrile (99.9 +<< %>> HPLC Grade) Glass test tubes

modes.label: Linking word after substances
modes.description: 'which' or 'that' right after a named drug or solution, introducing a clause about its chemical property or effect.
modes.example: The metabolism of clopidogrel to its active metabolite can be impaired by use with concomitant medications, such as omeprazole,<< that>> inhibit CYP2C19 activity

card.writes: It lowers chemistry-related words and raises physics-related words, so it steers away from chemistry terms.
card.plain: It lights up in chemistry-heavy text such as journal citations and reagent lists, at spots where the next word would not be 'chemistry'.
